SQLite 3.53.1

The SQLite authors dedicate the deliverable SQLite code and documentation to
the public domain. This note records the upstream statement; it is not a new
license or a warranty of title.

Official statement: https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html
Reviewed: 2026-09-11

Version source: sqlite3.sqlite_version from the Python runtime used to build
Stock Workshop. Build-system dependencies and other native libraries require
their own provenance review.
